rust.name: crates/domain/src/heavy.rs:513:52: replace > with < in behind
rust.why: The scenarios check the explanation exactly at the deadline and check ordering after it, leaving the overdue explanation unasserted.

rust.name: crates/host/src/clock.rs:23:9: replace Clock::offset_min -> i32 with 1
rust.why: The window scenario checks well before opening and after a coarse clock advance, so a one-minute early opening can pass.

rust.name: crates/domain/src/admission.rs:58:69: replace > with >= in holds
rust.why: This blocks worker admission exactly at the queue wait bound, an instant the shown scenarios do not assert.

rust.name: crates/domain/src/heavy.rs:404:60: replace && with || in Queue::resources
rust.why: This can show a waiter in an unrelated resource's queue, while the new ordering scenarios inspect only the resource the waiter requested.
